name: stint
description: A queue of unattended work for Claude Code. Queue items with `stint add`, leave, and `/stint:run` works them one at a time while `stint next` answers start, wait or stop: bounded by PaceLine's advice (budget, agents, waits, safety stops) when PaceLine is installed, and by its own stops at the weekly and five-hour limits when it is not. A module hands the limits Claude Code shows in the status line to state/stint, so Stint can stop without PaceLine. Takes over the queue PaceLine 0.6.0 and earlier kept. Requires Claude Code 2.1.287+ and Python 3.9+.
